People: Auguste Frédéric Louis Viesse de Marmont (author, Wikidata Q312676), died 1852. Printed edition: Mémoires du duc de Raguse de 1792 à 1832, imprimés sur le manuscrit original de l'auteur, Paris, Perrotin, 1857, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/mmoiresduducder01unkngoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 80%, 81%, 75% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
